### 📓 Docs Drift Check
**20** anchor(s) derived from **1** changed package(s); no hand-written page names any of them, so this run has **nothing to list** — **not a clean bill of health**. This check sees only pages that NAME a derived anchor: one that documents this change in prose, or enumerates it in an authoring dialect, names none and stays invisible to it on every run.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **7** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **65** of **247** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **182** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **182**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **59** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **123** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **3** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 35c9a305f06a37fe941d424fe0160727e20c0808` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `d127470de65bbc20f4b5d5485a2f46796ecb1521` — the merge of head `7e9abb650ba152eb685bdb9e5de4c881a796e38d` into base `35c9a305f06a37fe941d424fe0160727e20c0808`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin d127470de65bbc20f4b5d5485a2f46796ecb1521 && git checkout d127470de65bbc20f4b5d5485a2f46796ecb1521
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 35c9a305f06a37fe941d424fe0160727e20c0808 7e9abb650ba152eb685bdb9e5de4c881a796e38d && git checkout -B drift-repro 35c9a305f06a37fe941d424fe0160727e20c0808 && git merge --no-ff 7e9abb650ba152eb685bdb9e5de4c881a796e38d

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 35c9a305f06a37fe941d424fe0160727e20c0808
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

## 席位核对 · PR #34331 · L1-b · 2026-11-16T10:22Z
Head-sha: `7e9abb650ba152eb685bdb9e5de4c881a796e38d`

**L1 ACCEPT**(带一条落地前正文改正)· area o1-C 定稿评论 6913234084 所钉 head。

1. 形态:draft,目标 `main`,首行 `Fixes #34046`;卡「What done looks like」两条(destroy 有界等待或在驱动释放前把行落为终态;关停时有在跑定时任务的测试,断言不留 `running`、关停后无驱动失败日志)本 PR 全部交付,关卡正确。7 文件 +573/−38,无受管路径,无 `packages/spec/**`,不欠 L2。
2. 前提实测(亲读 head 源码):
   - `IntervalJobAdapter`/`CronJobAdapter.destroy()`:先停 timer、清注册,再 `drainScheduledFires(scheduledInFlight, shutdownDrainMs)`;超时一条 `warn` 点名。`drainScheduledFires` 的 bound timer 在 `finally` 清掉,不外泄。
   - 「destroy 期间到点的 tick 不再起跑」:interval 侧本 PR 新加 `this.jobs.get(record.name) !== record` 守卫;cron 侧 head 上 `runScheduled` 首行 `if (!record) return` 原已存在。两侧均成立。
   - `DbJobAdapter`:`shuttingDown` 先置位 → 依次 drain `inner` 与 cron → `settleInterruptedRuns` 先 `await run.write` 再 `interrupt()`。核三种时序:行插入未开始(`onAttemptStart` 见 `shuttingDown` 直接抛,不写)、插入进行中(等插入完再落 `failed`,且 `onAttemptStart` 自身也补落)、attempt 在跑(落 `failed`+`INTERRUPTED_BY_SHUTDOWN`,`bumpJob` 记失败;其后 handler 自己的 settle 被 `settled` 闩挡住、零写)。只追踪 `trigger === 'schedule'`,手动 `trigger()`/`replay()` 不变,与卡及正文一致。不新增状态值。
   - 测试:新 pin 文件按「kernel 释放后 insert/update 一律抛」建模,两腿(无 cron 回退 / 真 `CronJobAdapter`)各断言终态行、`afterRelease` 零调用、无驱动失败 warn;对 main 反向读数与 A1–A4 四条 ablation 均在 PR 正文,每条红行点名到腿与断言。
3. 门禁 check-runs(head `7e9abb65`):51 条,success 或 skipped,零 failure、零 pending;`Lint & Repo Gates`、`TypeScript Type Check`、`Test Core (1/8)…(8/8)`、`Lint · CI, release & engine gates` 皆 success。
4. 接受的偏差:
   - `scripts/engine-double-contract.pinned.json` 新增一行(本 PR 自身 pin 文件的 `update` double,生成物,312b7793 由 `check-engine-double-contract.mjs --write` 写出,0 lost)。这是本 PR 测试的账本登记,不是范围外修复,接受。
   - 有 cron 时 `DbJobAdapter.destroy()` 先后 drain 两个 adapter,最坏约 2×10 s,仍在内核 60 s 关停预算内;记明。
   - 「关停后不起重试」只在 `DbJobAdapter` 包裹下成立(changeset 该句写在 `DbJobAdapter` 条目内,措辞准确);裸 `IntervalJobAdapter` 的重试不受此门。记明,不判 REWORK。
5. 范围外去向:`## Acceptance notes` 三条(cron 锁在内核走后才释放可能多一条既有 warn、手动运行按令不在范围、`JobServicePlugin` 占位移交现在也有界等待)均为已述副作用,无须立卡。`Skills-docs:` 不适用(`Metadata-protocol: none`)。changeset 逐句核(`@objectstack/service-job` patch,包未设 `private`):「内核逆序销毁、job 服务先于驱动」「两 adapter 原先停 timer 即返回」「默认 10000 ms、在 60 s 内」「destroy 期间到点 tick 不起跑」「超时一条 warn、DbJobAdapter 在驱动走前落 `failed`+中断文案、`sys_job` 按失败记」「放弃的 handler 晚到不再写行」「`DbJobAdapterOptions.shutdownDrainMs` 只管自带 timer,外传 cron 用其自身选项」「手动 trigger/replay 不变」均与 diff 一致。
6. 落地条款 · **落地前须改 PR 正文一处(不动 head,本 ACCEPT 不失效)**:`## Verification` 里「`check:engine-double-contract` exit 1, still red at `9993f237ea` … the row is not added here」已不属实——该行已由 312b7793 加入,本 head CI 绿。改成一句写明该行在 312b7793 加入、本 head 由 CI 判绿。改完照 `landing-operations.md` 自落(非受管,`check-governed-merges --pr 34331` 已读 not governed)。head 再移 ⇒ 只对 delta 补读。
